blocks.text: With Philips A4216 Wireless Sports Headphones, you never have to hold yourself back. Whether you’re sweating it out at the gym or enjoying a laid-back weekend at the beach, these Go series headphones are up to the challenge. 35 hours of playback time can power a whole week’s worth of workouts, while the built-in mic allows you to take calls on the go. The soft, breathable ear-cup cushions are specially designed for superior comfort and removable for cleaning. No matter what you do when you're wearing these headphones, you'll always be able to get them feeling fresh again! IP55 water and dust resistance also lets you exercise with peace of mind.

items.label: HERE COMES THE BASS
items.value: These wireless over-ear headphones give you deeper bass! Powerful 40mm drivers bring out the best in your favourite tracks so you can hear every note. And the closed-back design ensures your tunes stay yours!

items.label: ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
items.value: It gives you 35 hours of playback from over 700 songs, whether you're on the treadmill or at the beach, on just a 2-hour charge via USB-C. And when you need a little extra juice, a 15-minute boost gives you an extra 2 hours.

items.label: BE READY FOR SPORTS
items.value: The tough, lightweight headphone is built for active lifestyles, allowing you to take calls, pause music, call voice assistant with a single press. The IP55 rating means they are as happy on dusty trail as they are in heavy rain.

items.label: DESIGNED FOR COMFORT
items.value: These 230g over-ear Bluetooth headphones have a cushioned headband that is so light you can barely feel it. Removable and washable ear-cup covers keep you comfortable whether you're on the treadmill or at the beach.

items.label: AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
items.value: You can take calls, pause music, call upon your voice assistant with a press of a multi-function button. Bluetooth 5.0 lets you connect seamlessly to the smartphone, so the headphones are ready to pair as soon as you turn them on.

items.label: EASY STORAGE
items.value: The ear cups can be fold flat and swivel inward, so they can easily fit in your pocket or handbag. The sleek design of the wireless headphones looks great whether you're going for your personal best or just having fun at the weekend.
